test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

__Garnish__ the drink with cranberries or a slice of fresh peach.
solution:
The correct answer is **'embellish'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garnish **means decorate or adorn, especially food.

 
 
• Example- **Garnish** each serving with a dollop of sour cream.
 
 
 
• **Embellish** means making something more attractive by adding decorative details or features.
 
 
• Example- It was a blue silk lehenga **embellished** with golden embroidery.
 
 
 
• It is clear that both the meanings are similar. So **'****embellish'** is the most appropriate choice among the other options.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wend** means going in a specified direction, typically slowly or by an indirect route.

 
 
• Example- They** wended** their way across the city.
 
 
 
• **Blemish** means a small mark or spot which spoils the appearance of something.
 
 
• Example- The girl's hands were without a **blemish**.
 
 
 
• **Dismantle **means to take to pieces.
 
 
• Example-The engines were **dismantled **and the bits piled into a heap.
